rites.name: Corania
rites.text: A nameless presence that tribal folk speak aloud when casting a flying sweeping spell. Its true nature remains a mystery, possibly a spirit, an ancestor, or a place.

rites.name: Amonus
rites.text: A chanted word of power that is spoken inside incantations. Within one ritual it turns a plain weapon into an enchanted blade, and within another it releases a blinding flash while a written scroll disappears.

rites.name: Mirniallia
rites.text: A pair of enchanted blades that are not physical weapons but a sorcerous working. They are wielded as a spell by a dark ruler to strike at a wizard.

rites.name: Orianium
rites.text: An ancient sacred ward used by a dark-scholar to keep fiendish creatures from crossing a sealed boundary. Its exact nature remains a mystery to those who study old mystic lore.

rites.name: Vasum Amaullum
rites.text: A practitioner who draws strange power from hidden, otherworldly sources and wields it with great skill. Such folk are known by several names across the lands.
